name: Status tools
description: A status-bar item and keyboard shortcuts for two small commands (manifest version 2).

commands.title: Show the chat title
commands.description: Shows the open chat's title and how many words it has.

commands.title: Ask for a short answer
commands.description: Prepares a request for a shorter answer for you to review.
commands.insertText: Please keep the next answer short: five bullet points at most.

statusItems.tooltip: Show the open chat's title (Status tools plugin)
